templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement governing a provider's AI services, including use of customer input and generated output, model training restrictions, and related responsibilities.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a customer.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a SaaS/cloud service subscription, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term and termination. Used with a cover page and order forms.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback and participation in product development.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data Processing Agreement defining processor and subprocessor obligations for customer personal data, including processing instructions, restricted (international) transfers, security incident response, audits, and data deletion (GDPR-oriented).

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA governing how each party may use and must protect the other's confidential information disclosed for a stated purpose.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction) and party signatures; incorporates the MNDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships covering each party's obligations, payments, trademark licensing, confidentiality, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a limited-time product pilot or trial allowing a customer to evaluate a product before committing to a full purchase.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service Level Agreement defining target uptime and response times for a cloud service, and the remedies (such as service credits) available when targets are missed.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing installable software to a customer, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, warranties, indemnification, confidentiality, and liability.
